subject: PICTURE clause
notes: LANDED 2026-09-19 (kb/Work PB532). "The maximum number of characters allowed in character-string-1 is 63" now has a site: Analyze's prologue measures character-string-1 AS WRITTEN, after DataBinder.Constants.ExpandPicConstants has substituted every constant-name, and reports COBOL2146. The as-written reading is SR6's second sentence's ('the length of the integer, not the length of the constant-name, is counted toward the maximum number of characters in character-string-1'), and it is what keeps PIC X(30000) - four written characters, 30000 character positions - legal; the expanded reading would outlaw it. MEASURED: 64 written X's draw COBOL2146 at every edition (conformance:cases/13.18.40-PICTURE/pb532-picture-string-over-63), the 63-character control compiles (R3 of the positive witness, SIZE=63), and PIC X(30000) compiles with SIZE=30000. Before this the constant 63 appeared nowhere on the PICTURE path at any edition while docs/DATA_MODEL_DESIGN.md D21 listed 'SR4 (63 characters)' among its anchors - a doc/code divergence as well as a missing rule. Editions: ALL FORMATS, identical text at 85/2002/2014/2023.
